notes.title: Foragery Demo: Broadcast
notes.notes: I will be streaming the demo of my upcoming adventure game, Foragery. A game about being stranded on an unknown island without any recollection of how you got there, you must collect materials to construct a boat and escape the island whilst simultaneously uncovering a mystery beneath the surface. I will try to answer any questions I possibly can! Enjoy!

notes.title: Foragery in the next Steam Next Fest.
notes.notes: [b]Hey all![/b] I will be registering Foragery in the upcoming Steam Next Fest! I am working on the Demo in order to get it out for the Next Fest. Have a great rest of your day and thank you for supporting my work!
